findings.evidence: Page 16 (Preface), Fig P.1: The figure shows four stages: 01 Understand, 02 Design & size, 03 Validate & Defend, 04 Commit. The caption states "Two loops are drawn... the inner loop, labelled 're-derive', returns a failed benchmark or TCO validation from 'Validate & Defend' to 'Design & size'". However the figure's visible edge labels (as extracted) show: "iterate" and "re-derive" as the two loop edges. The caption says the inner loop is labelled "re-derive" — and the figure text shows "re-derive" as an edge label ✓. The caption also says the outer loop is labelled "iterate" — the figure text shows "iterate" as an edge label ✓. Consistent.
findings.issue: No defect — Figure P.1's loop labels match the caption description.

findings.evidence: Page 17, Fig P.2: Caption states "B (right): question-by-question: six independent navigation prompts, each mapped to the chapter that answers it." The figure text shows: "token → cost? Ch4; fits host? → KV Ch3/7; which phase binds? Ch2/8; 1 host or fleet? Ch17; who serves it? Ch10/11/20; is it the right call? Ch16/22/25". Cross-checking against the checklist on pp.11-12: Q1 workload → Ch.4 ✓; Q2 fits on one host → Chs.3,7 ✓; Q3 which phase binds → Chs.2,8 ✓; Q4 how many hosts → Chs.16-17 (figure says Ch17 only); Q5 who serves → Chs.10-11,20 ✓; Q6 is it right → Chs.16,22,25 ✓. Q4 discrepancy: checklist says "Chs.16–17" but figure says only "Ch17". However the caption notes: "Where Fig. P.2's link for a question names a different chapter set from the checklist item, the checklist is the normative list and the figure's link is a starting point." This explicitly resolves the discrepancy ✓.
findings.issue: No defect — the Q4 chapter-reference discrepancy between figure and checklist is explicitly acknowledged and resolved by the caption's normativity rule on p.18.
findings.fix_instruction: No fix needed; resolved by stated convention.
